sn37.11:1.1: Pañcahi Anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || nirayam upapajjati || katamehi pañcahi || || Assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottāpī ca hoti appassuto ca hoti duppañño ca hoti || || Imehi kho Anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || nirayam upapajjatī ti || ||
